node.question: In the edited image, is the same blue-covered book from the source visibly behind the same rose from the source, with the rose in front, as shown by relative depth or occlusion?
node.criteria: Pass if the source book and source rose are identifiable and visible evidence establishes the book behind that rose. Fail if the identifiable objects clearly are not in that relation. Unknown if object identity or their relative depth cannot be determined; do not assume changed-looking objects are replacements.
node.binding: Compare the edited image with the source image to identify the blue-covered book and rose, then assess only their requested behind/in-front relation using visible placement and occlusion cues. Occlusion is strong evidence but is not mandatory if other clear depth cues establish the relation.
